preconditions.description: The number of rows n is between 1 and 1000.
The number of columns m is between 1 and 1000.
The number of colors k is between 1 and the minimum of 40 and the product of n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i][j] <= k for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each city color a[i][j] is between 1 and k.
The number of missions q is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= r1 <= n and 1 <= c1 <= m and 1 <= r2 <= n and 1 <= c2 <= m for r1, c1, r2, c2 in missions)
preconditions.description: Each mission's starting and finishing city coordinates are within the grid bounds.

postconditions.description: The number of output times is equal to the number of missions.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(time, int) and time >= 0 for time in output)
postconditions.description: Each output time is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(time == 0 if (r1, c1) == (r2, c2) else time > 0 for (r1, c1, r2, c2), time in zip(missions, output))
postconditions.description: The time is 0 if the starting and finishing cities are the same, otherwise it is positive.
